label: EXPLORATORY / DEVELOPMENT_ONLY / NOT_CONFIRMATORY_EVIDENCE

identical_across_ALL_arms: base system prompt EXCEPT the arm's reflection module
model_control_invariants.differs_across_arms_ONLY_in: the injected reflection material (none / generic / concern+concept / varna-mappings)
model_control_invariants.arm_labels: sealed until unblinding; response order randomized per scenario

shared_pipeline_contract.S1_concern_extraction: held FIXED via the scenario's frozen_concern_ids during the primary analysis (identical inputs to arms C and D; arms A and B ignore it). Live extraction is a separate secondary study.

shared_pipeline_contract.final_response: natural language; for arm D no Sanskrit / Symbol-U / varna terminology may surface unless the user explicitly asks.

arms.name: generic_reflection
arms.injected_reflection: a generic second-pass reflection with NO ontology and NO Sanskrit, matched to arms C/D in reasoning budget and response length

arms.name: concern_ontology
arms.injected_reflection: concern-aware reflection grounded in the routed concern + the canonical concept's ORDINARY meaning; NO varna decomposition, NO mappings

arms.name: full_symbol_u
arms.injected_reflection: internal symbolic reasoning over the varna-level binding-vritti glosses of the concept's decomposition; final output natural, no Sanskrit unless asked
arms.purpose: adds the phonological varna layer; the D-C contrast isolates it

attribution_logic: B/C/D share identical model control + S1 + S5 and differ ONLY in injected reflection material, so each nested contrast attributes to exactly one added component: B-A = reflection; C-B = concern/concept framing; D-C = the varna (phonological) layer.
